text:
elisabeth: kicking off rollout for the routing policy tweak. canary at 5% for 15m, then 25% -> 50% -> 100%. need approvals and a change-window check. cc @samir @jun
samir: sounds good, can you paste the guard thresholds? also share the telemetry dashboard link
jun: heads up the analytics team has a deploy 2026-03-22T22:30Z — change window conflict if we start at 22:00Z
maria: can we move to 23:00Z-02:00Z? gives safe buffer. proposed guard: abort if error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency delta > 300ms
elisabeth: updated plan: start 2026-03-22T23:00Z. rollout steps + guards in config: ```yaml
rollout:
  steps: [5,25,50,100]
  step_duration: 15m
  guards:
    error_rate: 0.015
    p95_delta_ms: 300
```
samir: can deploy-bot open the release and ping approvers? want the approvals recorded in CI
deploy-bot: Deployment request created by @elisabeth for project: routing-service. Scheduled start: 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z. Approvers: samir, jun, arne. Change window: 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z -> 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/routing-rollout
arne: quick question — if we see capacity pressure will smart routing fallback to quantized variant for canary traffic?
jun: yes — routing policy will prefer model-quantized-v1 as fallback for canary. ops: note embedding quota could spike if some users hit heavy paths
maria: please add a telemetry alert: `rollout.regression.v1` -> notify #eng-sre + paging if threshold tripped. include a dashboard panel for canary vs stable p95 & error rate
samir: approving now. lgtm :thumbsup:
jun: approved
arne: approved
opsbot: Approval threshold reached (3/3). Deployment scheduled. Use `/deploy status 1776543210` to follow progress. Automated canary checks enabled: p95, error_rate, traffic_match
elisabeth: thanks — i'll monitor the dashboard during the window and post a short status update every step. will create follow-up notes in the release ticket if anything odd happens.
